headline: P&I is judged by what others do with its output
subline: Squad KPIs per user type · targets set after the December baseline
annotation: P&I contributes to the North Star; these KPIs measure that contribution.
source: Source: proposed targets; illustrative until baselined in December.
notes: How I know if P&I succeeds. We recommend and squads decide, so we are judged on what others do with our work, not on how many reports we ship. One pair of KPIs per user type.
People who decide: at least 70 percent of our outputs lead to a decision within two weeks, and squads rate us 8 out of 10 or better.
People who act: extra level-ups and prevented drops, always measured against holdout groups, so we only claim what we caused. My proposal is at least 10 thousand and 5 thousand by 30 June.
AI: the North Star, SoW and CM3 are available through an API, and we can swap a model in under a week with tests passing.
Targets are proposals; I set them after the December baseline.
